title: Family and Friend
label: ch:ml-family-and-friend
canDo: I can name my family as a group and name a friend in Malayalam, and say which of the two words is a Sanskrit loan and which of Malayalam's two friend-words leans on a borrowed ending even though its root is native.

payoff.summary: Say ithu ente kudumbamaanu and ithu ente suhruthaanu, take suhruthu apart into su plus hrid, and name the six Chapter 12 people-words next to the one group-word none of them supplied.
